༄༅/ /grub pa'i slob dpon dril bu lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i bdag bskyed snying po rnam nges zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// grub pa'i slob dpon dril bu lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i bdag bskyed snying po rnam nges zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang gnyis su med pa rje btsun bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir bla ma gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes bzhin/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs bde mchog lha lnga las bdag bskyed shin tu bsdus pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ de nyid kyi dbang bskur ba thob par byas la/ stan bde ba ro yi gdan du mos te 'dug la/ tho rangs gnyid sad pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ḍā ma ru'i sgras gnyid las bslang bar bsgom ste thal mo sbyar nas nam mkhar bltas la/ ngag tu/ oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi nī nīṃ kā ya waka tsit+ta pra ṇa mya badz+ra bhan+dha na ka ro mi/ zhes pas dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams la phyag byas/ sems can thams cad kyi ched du/ sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o// snyam pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du btang*/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas nga rgyal bzung de nas/ rang bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i thugs khar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis bla ma rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// zhes pas phyag 'tshal/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ rā se/ spar+she/ pañca a mṛ ta pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ rang phag mo dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas kyang mchod nas/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs brjod cing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas tshogs zhing gshegs su gsol/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom par bya ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ zhes sogs kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad sems tsam du bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas sems de yang stong pa nyid du bsgom/ sum+bha ni'i sngags dang se gol phyogs bzhir byas pas srung 'khor/ de'i ngang las suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can rtse mo lcog brgyad kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems hūm̐ sngon po dang baṃ dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can thams cad he ru ka'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ dang baṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun he ru ka sku mdog zar ma'i me tog gsar pa lta bu/ zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ shes rab ma la 'khyud pa'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang pas 'jigs byed chen po dang*/ g.yon bskum pas dus mtshan mnan pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ ral pa'i cod pan dang spyi gtsug nor bus brgyan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pa dbu la 'dzin pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ gsum khugs su 'khyog cing gyes pa'i cha byad kyi dar dpyangs kyi cod pan gyis mdzes par byas pa/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba'i thod can sgeg pa la sogs pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa'i mchog mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal gyis sku la brgyan pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi 'phreng ba can/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa'o// de'i mdun na bcom ldan 'das ma dpal rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo gzhon zhing mdzes ma lang tsho dang ldan pa zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/

phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis gdug pa can thams cad bsdigs ma/ phyag g.yon yab la 'khyud pas bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ dpral ba'i mtshams su thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ dbu skra nag po'i tshogs grol ba/ nam mkha'i na bza' mnabs pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan ma/ mi mgo skam po'i 'phreng ba can/ g.yas kyi byin pas 'khyud cing g.yon brkyang ba/ bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid can/ de lta bu dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' bas brgyan pa'i bcom ldan 'das bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid chen po dang ldan pa sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ de gnyis kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam te/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du mos te/ oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya'o/ /yab kyi thugs kar oṃ haḥdakar po/ dpral bar na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swa ha hu dmar po/ phrag par bau ṣa ṭa he nag po/ mig la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ haṃ ljang khu/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ paṃ dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yauṃ sngon mo/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor hreṃ hriṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud kha rnams lha'i rang bzhin du mos par bya/ de nas rkang pa g.yon pas g.yas mnan/ mig gyen du blta gdong bsgyur zhing*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya g.yon du bskor nas/ pheṃ zhes brjod pas/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas sngar bzhin mchod de/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ sngar gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs pa la/ rnam lnga rol mos mchod/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dpa' bo rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ dpa' mo rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// zhes sogs kyis dbang bskur/ bkra shis kyi glu len/ dpa' bos bgegs bskrad/ de ltar dbang bskur bas lus ye shes kyi chus gang*/ yar lud pa las yab la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ yum la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur pa la sngar bzhin nyer spyod dang nang mchod/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i gsang mchod myangs te lus kyi lha tshim par bsam la/ oṃ a mṛ ta swa da na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ zhes brjod/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa bde ba chen po de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mchod/ rnal 'byor ro gcig bdud rtsi 'thungs pas rnam par dag pa'i thugs// gnas la sogs pa yul du bgrod pas rnam par dag pa'i sku// dpal gyi gnas mchod dbus mchog dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po dang*// bla ma mchog la spyi bos btud de rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// de nas shes sogs chen po'i gsung*// gang zhig rgyud kyi mdun 'gro ba// 'khor lo sdom pa'i 'dren pa mo// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// lha mo'i 'phreng ba rin po che rnams sku yis brgyan// dpa' bo rnams kyi rtag tu gnag pa'i sku rnam kun// 'khor lo gnas mchog lhan skyes dri ma med pa yang*// bde mchog rnal 'byor snying por rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ dung chen gyi 'phreng ba he ru kar gyur pa'i mi mgo'i 'phreng ba ltar bltas te/ lag pa g.yon gyis snying gar bzung la sngags kyi 'phreng ba rang gi zhal nas zhugs/ rdo rje nas pad+mar song*/ lha mo'i zhal nas 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi ye shes dang nus pa thams cad bkug nas thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes ming tshig gis bar ma chod par bzlas/

sgom bzlas la skyo bar gyur na mchod bstod bya/ dge rtsa bsngo/ smon lam gdab/ rang nyid he ru ka yab yum gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar/ phyogs bzhir se gol brdab cing zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod pas bsrung*/ byang sems kyis zin pas dngos po thams cad bde mchog gi rang bzhin du shes par bya'o// thun gyi mthar gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ thod pa la sogs pa'i snod du ci 'byor ba bshams pa la bdud rtsis bran bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mdun du sngar gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor pa spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ rdo rje thal mo gyen du kha phye ba'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ ṣ+ya hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhū dzaṃ tha/ pi wa tha/ ma ma kar+yaṃ sā dha ya tha/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod bstod 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// khrus dang zas nyal ba ldang ba la sogs pa rjes kyi rnal 'byor grub thob chen po'i yig cha de nyid bsdus pa la sogs pas shes par bya'o zhes slob dpon chen po dril bu zhabs kyi lugs bzhin/ bla ma gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes/ kho nar bzhag pa'i sgrub thabs snying po rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba rje bka' rgyud yab sras kyi gdam pas thugs kyi mdzod gang ba chos kyi rje rgyal dbang pas bskul ba'i ngor/ dge slong mi pham pad+ma dkar po phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes re zhig sbyar ba rdzogs so// maṅga laṃ/// /
